verdict.rationale: There is no documented export-all or offboarding feature. Some data is portable in practice: review configuration and custom agents live in a repo-root `cubic.yaml` file, PR-level metrics are available through the Analytics API, and review findings can be read through the MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented full data export (learned memories, review history, wiki, scan results), stated open export formats, data deletion/offboarding docs, and any hands-on corroboration of leaving with your data.
